pages.text: The Glue Activator automates JDT glue-related operations, automatically activating and processing glue blocks.$(br2)$(bold)Variants$()$(br2)| Machine | Upgrade Slots | Requires FE | |---------|--------------|-------------| | Basic Glue Activator | 4 | No | | Advanced Glue Activator | 4 | Yes | | Extended Glue Activator | 8 | Yes |$(br2)$(bold)Features$()$(br2)$(li)Automatically detects and activates glue blocks within range$(li)Supports redstone control, Range Upgrade, and Filter Upgrade$(li)Advanced and Extended versions support Overclock, Underclock, and Capacity Upgrades$(br2)$(bold)Crafting$()$(br2)$(bold)Basic Glue Activator$()
An extended version of the Advanced Glue Activator with 8 upgrade slots. Obtained by right-clicking an Advanced Glue Activator with an Extended Upgrade.
